name: Toast undo
oneLiner: a glass list sits in slow 3D, a fingertip swipes one item away and the rows close the gap, a dark toast rises with an Undo button and a draining countdown ring, the tap lands on Undo, the toast rolls over to a green Restored and the item flies back into its slot on a spring
say: when the speaker says you can take it back or nothing is lost ('deleted it by accident, one tap and it is back', 'you can always undo'): the swipe lands on 'deleted', the tap on 'undo', the item flies back on 'it is back'
